bibl.title: The Spearhead and Monogram Coinage of Ptolemy V.
bibl.seg: Eric Carlen, The Spearhead and Monogram Coinage of Ptolemy V.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Catalogue. - Comments on the coinage: The completeness of the corpus; - Die links; - The iconography of victory on Sv. 1249 and the purpose of the coinage. - Possible mint locations: The stylistic connection with Tyre; - The stylistic link with Salamis; - The case for a Sourthern Palestinian mint. - Further comments on the coinage: Remarks on forgeries; - The "no controls" variant of Sv. 1250. - Conclusions.
